description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'AbstractInstallerRestController' responsible for handling REST API requests in the OrangeHRM installer module. It manages request processing, content type handling, method dispatching (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), and exception handling with custom exceptions and logging.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerRestController
classes.description: An abstract class providing a REST controller framework for handling HTTP requests with method dispatching and exception handling in the installer module.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that processes incoming requests, handles JSON content type, dispatches to specific methods based on HTTP verb, and manages exceptions with appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Stub method for handling GET requests, intended to be overridden.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Stub method for handling POST requests, intended to be overridden.

methods.name: handlePut
methods.description: Stub method for handling PUT requests, intended to be overridden.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Stub method for handling DELETE requests, intended to be overridden.
